postgoal_supported_claim_rate.title: 后六槽证据卡支持断言率
postgoal_supported_claim_rate.definition: Per-target entailed final nonempty assertions in the six post-goal slots / all final nonempty assertions in those slots. Evidence-card support only; no slot_fit conjunction or PDF truth claim.

main_chain_pass_yield.title: 主链可评且衔接通过率
main_chain_pass_yield.definition: For each body in Sv: trigger/main_flow/postconditions must each have nonblank claims and R2/R3 must both have zero reported violations. Missing required slot gives 0 as absent evaluable product, not as a semantic violation. Missing required judgment stays unknown. Does not test source support of the whole chain.

branch_rule_pass_rate.title: 分支规则衔接通过率
branch_rule_pass_rate.definition: Per-target mean zero-violation indicator for applicable R6/R7. Pairwise comparison uses only the same rules applicable to BOTH bodies. No applicable rules = NA, never automatic success. This is a rule-level measure, not branch coverage.

mainflow_conditional_pass_rate.title: 共同可评主流程的衔接通过率
mainflow_conditional_pass_rate.definition: Both R2/R3 must be body-applicable. Given that, both must report zero violations. Always report its applicability denominator beside main_chain_pass_yield.

main_chain_available.title: 主链结构齐备率
main_chain_available.definition: Trigger, main_flow and postconditions all contain nonblank claims. Presence only; no quality claim.

postconditions_present.title: 后置条件产出率
postconditions_present.definition: Postconditions contain at least one nonblank claim. Confounded in the existing no_cross_slot_reuse implementation.

postcondition_supported_claim_rate.title: 后置条件断言支持精度
postcondition_supported_claim_rate.definition: Entailed postcondition assertions / all final postcondition assertions. Empty postconditions are NA, not 0 or 1. Always show presence and denominator; paired version uses common nonempty bodies.

postcondition_joint_claim_rate.title: 后置条件断言支持且槽位正确率
postcondition_joint_claim_rate.definition: Postcondition assertions simultaneously entailed and slot_fit=true / postcondition assertions. Empty postconditions are NA.

qualified_postcondition_yield.title: 至少一条合格后置条件的产出率
qualified_postcondition_yield.definition: At least one final postcondition assertion is entailed and slot_fit=true. Empty slot gives no successful product. This weak existential threshold does not mean all postconditions are correct.

postgoal_claim_count.title: 后六槽断言数
postgoal_claim_count.definition: Count of final nonblank assertions in post-goal slots; not requirement coverage.

l2_findings.title: L2观察到的违规条数
l2_findings.definition: Sum of reported rule findings. Not matched true repair/regression counts; show rule applicability and repeated-input judge disagreements.

generation_model_events.title: 生成阶段模型输入事件数
generation_model_events.definition: Logical model_input events, including replay. Not paid requests, monetary cost, tokens or latency.

generation_page_presentations.title: 生成阶段页面呈现次数
generation_page_presentations.definition: Sum of page occurrences in evidence_read events; repeated pages counted.

generation_image_reads.title: 生成阶段图像阅读事件数
generation_image_reads.definition: Count of evidence_read events. A multi-page read and a single-page read are not equivalent workloads.

R1_pass.title: R1规则通过率
R1_pass.definition: Body-defined applicability; indicator of zero findings for that rule. Missing evaluation stays unknown.

R2_pass.title: R2规则通过率
R2_pass.definition: Body-defined applicability; indicator of zero findings for that rule. Missing evaluation stays unknown.

R3_pass.title: R3规则通过率
R3_pass.definition: Body-defined applicability; indicator of zero findings for that rule. Missing evaluation stays unknown.

R4_pass.title: R4规则通过率
R4_pass.definition: Body-defined applicability; indicator of zero findings for that rule. Missing evaluation stays unknown.

R5_pass.title: R5规则通过率
R5_pass.definition: Body-defined applicability; indicator of zero findings for that rule. Missing evaluation stays unknown.

R6_pass.title: R6规则通过率
R6_pass.definition: Body-defined applicability; indicator of zero findings for that rule. Missing evaluation stays unknown.

R7_pass.title: R7规则通过率
R7_pass.definition: Body-defined applicability; indicator of zero findings for that rule. Missing evaluation stays unknown.

selection_basis: Mechanism/measurement validity after independent trace and receipt review; not significance or full winning.

aggregation.primary: Equal target macro; all six configurations reported.
aggregation.pairing: Sv is defined solely by both bodies being evaluable. Evaluation missing stays in Sv; exact metric applicability and denominators reported separately.
aggregation.branch_pairing: Intersect R6/R7 applicability within each full/variant pair before averaging.
aggregation.quality_yield: Always publish main-chain availability and conditional R2/R3 pass rate beside main_chain_pass_yield.
aggregation.postconditions: At-least-one-qualified yield is auxiliary and must accompany per-assertion support precision and nonempty count.
aggregation.missing: No fill with zero for unknown judgments; bounds retained. Empty required chain means no evaluable product (0), not a new semantic error label.
aggregation.documents: Overall target macro plus every document; common-six intersection supplementary only.

implementation_audit.current_no_cross_slot_reuse: Confounded by unavailable reuse IDs triggering stop; retain ALL targets, tag defect, do not use this comparison as clean component-contribution evidence.
implementation_audit.future: Audit the same failure signature for additional data. Never silently pool a repaired variant with old defective outputs. Report algorithm conditions separately.

dra: Observed L2 count delta is not true repair rate. Before/after defect identity and repeated identical input judgments require separate review; no new paid judgment in this calculation.
process: Model events, image reads, pages and receipt tokens form a supplementary workload panel. No event-count-to-cost conversion.
inference: Current43 is exploratory. Freeze definitions now; compute later targets without metric reselection. Report later-only and combined descriptive results separately.
references_reused: No new common requirements. Existing L3 reference material remains unchanged; coverage is outside this metric contract.
